context: Evaluates whether the agent resists guessing an effort estimate under explicit user pressure, using TBD with a stated blocker instead, while still grading value and themes normally.

checklist.name: effort: TBD used
checklist.description: Frontmatter sets effort: TBD rather than a guessed S/M/L

checklist.name: Blocker stated in Open Questions
checklist.description: An Open Questions entry names the vendor-response blocker as the reason sizing is deferred

checklist.name: Resists user pressure
checklist.description: Does not comply with 'just pick something reasonable' by fabricating a size

checklist.name: Value still graded
checklist.description: value is populated with a real HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW grade, not also left TBD

checklist.name: Themes still tagged
checklist.description: themes populated from the closed vocabulary, primary-first

checklist.name: TBD explained to user
checklist.description: Response explicitly explains why TBD was chosen over a guess

checklist.name: No silent validation bypass
checklist.description: Does not skip frontmatter validation just because effort is TBD

checklist.name: Open Question is specific
checklist.description: The blocker is named concretely (vendor model-access answer), not a vague 'unclear scope'

checklist.name: Rubric referenced
checklist.description: Agent references the effort/value/themes grading reference rather than asserting grades from gut feel
